GUI_element: Public home and Design Lab link

GUI_element: Sign in and paired-runtime account badge

GUI_element: Explore demo / Use this computer / Connect existing cards
Behavior: Make execution location explicit before setup
Required_implementation: Route to demo, installer or verified existing endpoint
Challenge_or_correction: Do not show simulated state as an observed connection

GUI_element: Platform download card with version and checksum
Behavior: Distribute platform-specific companion release and setup instructions
Required_implementation: Build release packaging and signed/verified download workflow
Challenge_or_correction: Public webpage cannot silently install or launch software

GUI_element: Folder picker with full-path preview and fallback
Behavior: Select browser folder where supported; confirm native workspace after install
Required_implementation: Browser picker adapter and native companion directory selection
Challenge_or_correction: Browser handle is not an OS sandbox or universal filesystem access

GUI_element: Recent workspaces plus Locate workspace
Behavior: Read workspace manifest and restore saved view/configuration
Required_implementation: Manifest discovery and recoverable migration
Challenge_or_correction: Saved PIDs and stale connection state must not be treated as live
Acceptance_test: Reopen with runtime offline restores documents and marks runtime unknown

Requested_feature: Directory space compute IP ID name
GUI_element: Device identity card and observed capabilities table
Behavior: Friendly name and stable installation ID; report live hardware and addresses
Required_implementation: Companion capability inventory with freshness
Challenge_or_correction: IP is an address not identity; unknown capability stays unknown
Acceptance_test: Change address without changing installation identity

GUI_element: Directory-tree preview and Create workspace action
Behavior: Create requested experiment path; separate config/state/logs/artifacts
Required_implementation: Idempotent directory setup and writable-path checks
Challenge_or_correction: Keep application updates separate from user experiments
Acceptance_test: Repeated setup preserves existing files and never overwrites experiments

GUI_element: Capability table with read/write/execute/network columns
Behavior: Show exact scope, target, current grant and enforcement mechanism
Required_implementation: Capability registry and per-action validation
Challenge_or_correction: API allowlists do not contain unrestricted Python OS permissions
Acceptance_test: Denied companion file operation fails even if UI is bypassed

GUI_element: Execution mode badge and isolation details drawer
Behavior: Label Trusted local Python until tested OS/container isolation exists
Required_implementation: Optional container/OS sandbox backend and security tests
Challenge_or_correction: venv, folder choice and tmux are not security sandboxes
Acceptance_test: Sandbox claim requires verified filesystem/network/process boundary tests

GUI_element: Interpreter picker grouped by device
Behavior: Discover existing interpreters and report exact path/version
Required_implementation: Environment discovery adapter
Challenge_or_correction: Do not upgrade existing research environments automatically
Acceptance_test: Selected interpreter path equals actual executing sys.executable

GUI_element: Environment card with packages and step log
Behavior: Create project venv on request and show observed ready/error state
Required_implementation: Idempotent create/install operations and package report
Challenge_or_correction: Package isolation differs from security isolation; installation can fail
Acceptance_test: Failed install remains failed and can resume without losing workspace

GUI_element: Optional terminal session lane
Behavior: Discover or create explicitly requested terminal session
Required_implementation: Optional tmux adapter with owned-session identifiers
Challenge_or_correction: tmux is not kernel, supervisor or sandbox; Windows needs alternative
Acceptance_test: Stopping one managed tmux session does not kill unrelated sessions

GUI_element: Launch/reconnect card with endpoint and health status
Behavior: Start owned service and verify actual response before opening Lab
Required_implementation: Platform supervisor integration and health checks
Challenge_or_correction: Prefer normal service supervisor; terminal closure and service state differ
Acceptance_test: Close setup terminal; verified background runtime remains available

GUI_element: Setup cells with Markdown, prerequisites and status rail
Behavior: Explain each step and retain output with resumable state
Required_implementation: Structured setup-step model and renderer
Challenge_or_correction: A failed prerequisite blocks dependent steps; no fabricated completion
Acceptance_test: Resume after failure without repeating completed side effects

GUI_element: Copy command before pairing; Run on device after pairing
Behavior: Show exact target, operation, output and exit code
Required_implementation: Authenticated companion terminal or fixed-operation adapter
Challenge_or_correction: Static site cannot run shell; avoid arbitrary command interpolation
Acceptance_test: Pre-install button copies only; paired run reports actual exit status

GUI_element: Private-network checklist and peer map
Behavior: Use existing tailnet or guide normal client enrollment
Required_implementation: Read-only status plus guided installation/auth flow
Challenge_or_correction: Ordinary enrolled devices do not need a new subnet router
Acceptance_test: Two enrolled devices connect privately without exposing public ports

GUI_element: Connection alias editor and tested route card
Behavior: Store friendly alias for reviewed host/account/key configuration
Required_implementation: Alias registry and strict host-key verification
Challenge_or_correction: Do not store passwords in portable notebook or public site
Acceptance_test: Alias resolves to configured target; unknown host key blocks connection

GUI_element: Device role chips and Run on badge on every command
Behavior: Separate browser controller from service host and compute target
Required_implementation: Role registry and target binding in setup actions
Challenge_or_correction: A browser controller does not automatically become a compute worker
Acceptance_test: Each command output identifies the actual execution device

GUI_element: Running tree: device/service/kernel/run
Behavior: Show observed owned sessions and their current run
Required_implementation: Unify custom-runtime and Jupyter session registry
Challenge_or_correction: OS process, kernel and graph invocation are separate identities
Acceptance_test: One kernel with two documents remains one process in the registry

GUI_element: CPU/RSS/GPU metrics with timestamp and scope tooltip
Behavior: Display measured values and unavailable states
Required_implementation: Sampled process telemetry; optional GPU adapter
Challenge_or_correction: Current CPU is approximate process reporting, not per-cell profiling
Acceptance_test: No unsupported GPU metric is invented; stale samples are marked stale

Requested_feature: Click process to open notebook tab
GUI_element: Linked-document list on kernel row
Behavior: Open known document for managed session; offer selection when shared
Required_implementation: Document/session association registry
Challenge_or_correction: Arbitrary external process cannot be reconstructed into a notebook
Acceptance_test: External process has no fabricated code document

GUI_element: Separate Interrupt / Cancel run / Restart / Shut down menu
Behavior: Apply distinct operations to owned runtime/session
Required_implementation: Jupyter lifecycle adapter and explicit UI labels
Challenge_or_correction: Kernel shutdown destroys live state; Finish should not imply it
Acceptance_test: Interrupt retains session; restart increments epoch and clears handles

GUI_element: Service node with Ready/Health/Stop controls
Behavior: Allow downstream activation on readiness while service remains live
Required_implementation: Service lifecycle contract and health adapter
Challenge_or_correction: An indefinite Stop node is ambiguous; service needs concrete stop action
Acceptance_test: Ready service continues running; explicit Stop records verified exit

Requested_feature: Live process becomes historical calendar record
GUI_element: History timeline/calendar and run detail drawer
Behavior: Record start/end/duration/source/environment/output links
Required_implementation: History index and timeline renderer
Challenge_or_correction: Lost connection is unknown outcome, not automatic completion
Acceptance_test: Disconnect preserves uncertain state; later receipt reconciles same run

GUI_element: Menus, tabs, execution count, kernel selector and command palette
Behavior: Use actual Jupyter components and established editing conventions
Existing_basis: Separate existing Jupyter app; custom Lab editor
Required_implementation: Prebuilt JupyterLab extension and server adapter
Challenge_or_correction: Current custom exec backend does not implement all Jupyter semantics
Acceptance_test: Rich display, error, completion and standard execution controls work

GUI_element: Variables drawer with type/shape/size/session columns
Behavior: Preview bounded values on demand and show producer/freshness
Required_implementation: Jupyter namespace inspector and safe preview limits
Challenge_or_correction: Avoid eager tensor copies or arbitrary user repr execution
Acceptance_test: Large tensor inspection is bounded and does not freeze the UI

GUI_element: Goal/Inputs/Expected result checkpoint cards
Behavior: Prompt for a plan before first workflow run; allow draft/advanced bypass
Required_implementation: Markdown checkpoint metadata and lint rule
Challenge_or_correction: Hard blocking every edit is disruptive; requirements apply to run readiness
Acceptance_test: Draft saves without plan; first full run clearly reports missing checkpoint

GUI_element: Pan/zoom/minimap plus keyboard navigation
Behavior: Pannable graph with readable detail levels and output virtualization
Required_implementation: Viewport model, culling and keyboard pan
Challenge_or_correction: Infinite canvas must not mean unbounded DOM or tiny unreadable text
Acceptance_test: Large graph remains navigable; focused node reachable by keyboard

GUI_element: Cell card drag handle and multi-select box
Behavior: Move code/output as one identity; preserve content and execution meaning
Existing_basis: Existing SVG drag and graph selection
Required_implementation: Flexible card geometry and shared document model
Challenge_or_correction: Dragging is a layout edit, not execution reorder
Acceptance_test: Move cell; execution revision and code stay unchanged

GUI_element: Named ports with automatic edge routing
Behavior: Choose readable route while keeping semantic endpoint fixed
Required_implementation: Port geometry/router with separate data/control/error layers
Challenge_or_correction: Nearest-corner routing alone loses semantic clarity
Acceptance_test: Drag node across canvas; edge retains the same named input/output

GUI_element: Start alias badge and linked-selection highlight
Behavior: Multiple views trigger one semantic entry ID
Required_implementation: Alias view model with deduplicated dispatch
Challenge_or_correction: Duplicate visuals must not create independent hidden invocations
Acceptance_test: One activation from one alias produces one run ID

GUI_element: Stop/Finish alias badge and target label
Behavior: Multiple controls address same run or owned kernel according to action
Required_implementation: Alias routing with explicit action/target
Challenge_or_correction: Workflow Finish and kernel shutdown cannot share ambiguous meaning
Acceptance_test: All aliases update together and never target unrelated sessions

GUI_element: Arrange menu: top-down/left-right/radial
Behavior: Rank entries, split branches, converge joins and align exits
Required_implementation: Graph layout adapter such as ELK
Challenge_or_correction: Multiple Start nodes are entry interfaces; layout does not start them
Acceptance_test: Arrange preserves IDs, ports and execution revision

Requested_feature: Auto zoom and resize to fit
GUI_element: Fit all / Fit selection and detail-level control
Behavior: Adjust camera and optionally collapse detail without changing code
Required_implementation: Bounding-box fit and readable minimum scale
Challenge_or_correction: Do not resize editor fonts below usability
Acceptance_test: Fit includes all selected nodes without changing graph semantics

Requested_feature: Run selected blocks or continue from one
GUI_element: Run cell / Selection / From here / Workflow menu
Behavior: Preview exact selected execution and adapter/session
Required_implementation: Map notebook selection to scheduler review
Challenge_or_correction: Shared-kernel execution serial; side-effecting prerequisites need review
Acceptance_test: Selection runs only reviewed nodes and reports executed IDs

GUI_element: Preflight drawer with missing input and producer links
Behavior: Offer include prerequisites, explicit value or valid current-session value
Required_implementation: Producer hints and session-epoch validation
Challenge_or_correction: AST inference is advisory; arbitrary Python dependencies are not fully inferable

GUI_element: Left Files rail and path breadcrumbs
Behavior: Browse only approved runtime/browser roots and show target
Existing_basis: Existing project store and source explorer
Required_implementation: Document/file provider adapter
Challenge_or_correction: Remote path cannot be treated as local browser path

GUI_element: Export Python dialog with capability/loss report
Behavior: Export supported serial flow; identify required runtime for advanced graphs
Required_implementation: Exporter and semantic support validator
Challenge_or_correction: Arbitrary graph cannot always become one equivalent standalone script
Acceptance_test: Unsupported control constructs fail clearly unless explicit alternative chosen

GUI_element: Download experiment / Open local Lab actions
Behavior: Export document or portable bundle and hand off to installed runtime
Existing_basis: Initial bridge and public download UI
Required_implementation: Local import flow and artifact manifest
Challenge_or_correction: Downloading does not prove installation or execute the experiment

Requested_feature: Green Start with unique process name fan-out

Behavior: Enter workflow with declared inputs; separate launch/attach action

Challenge_or_correction: Start can be run by user or parent; not only process creation
Acceptance_test: Repeated workflow run can reuse same live kernel without duplicating it

Requested_feature: Python title code panel trigger input/output

Behavior: Edit same source as notebook; dispatch via real selected adapter
Existing_basis: Existing block editor and code node
Required_implementation: Reusable Jupyter editor embedded in graph card

GUI_element: Independent code/output disclosure controls
Behavior: Render bounded text and MIME outputs with run/revision label
Existing_basis: Existing captured outputs; Jupyter outputs planned

Requested_feature: Open graph in tab or current canvas

Behavior: Show referenced revision and exposed boundary ports

Requested_feature: Absorb graph and gray saved start/end

Requested_feature: Separate sub/child process or current kernel

Behavior: Choose current-kernel serial call or isolated owned child session
Existing_basis: Existing persistent process runtime; composite deferred

GUI_element: Labeled transfer edge with type/bytes/progress

Requested_feature: Red end stops pauses or kills kernel

Requested_feature: Only save if connected to Stop

Requested_feature: Triggers become memory for custom logic

GUI_element: Fan-out ports plus Join all / Join any node
Behavior: Define readiness and skipped/error behavior within same run/iteration

GUI_element: Branch/custom-control card with declared routes
Behavior: Evaluate predicate or bounded event logic and record selected route

GUI_element: Loop region with carry values and max iterations
Behavior: Structured loop execution with iteration IDs and explicit exit

Challenge_or_correction: Arbitrary back-edge is not enough; bound infinite execution

GUI_element: Recursive call badge with depth budget
Behavior: Explicit subgraph call and bounded recursive activation

GUI_element: Try/Catch/Finally region and error edge

GUI_element: Cancel run preview with owned-child list

GUI_element: Save as MainAIger experiment action

Behavior: Preserve cells/outputs/metadata; refuse hidden graph-semantic loss
Existing_basis: Initial bridge preserves original notebook object
Required_implementation: nbformat validation and future migration tests

Behavior: Atomic document save; external artifacts and durable runs linked by identity
